name: agentmash
description: agentmash for Claude Code, and plugins for teams running many Claude Code agents on one repository, and for running science with them.

plugins.name: agentmash
plugins.description: Your team's coding agents see each other: before your agent edits a file, it is told which teammate's agent is in it, on what branch and what they are doing. The hooks of npx agentmash login, as a plugin.

plugins.name: agentmash-crew
plugins.description: 22 role agents with a shared crew protocol for parallel Claude Code work on one repository.

plugins.name: agentmash-lab
plugins.description: 10 science agents run by the crew's coordinator: hypotheses with cross-field prior art, pre-registration locks, verified data, registered analyses, controls, an evidence judge, and venue agents for IEEE, ISEF, ML conferences and journals.
